observation.visible_scene: A single lit candle stands centered in the lower half of the frame against a pure black background. The candle body is pale cream/white with an uneven melted rim and a small notch on its right edge; a short dark wick protrudes into a tall teardrop-shaped flame whose core is bright white-yellow with a thin blue zone at the base. From roughly the middle of the excerpt onward, a horizontal lower-third graphic band fades in across the bottom of the frame, carrying the text 'Inner peace guided meditation' and the URL 'WWW.ROSALEAH.COM'.
visible_changes: Throughout the whole excerpt the flame continuously flickers: its height, width and brightness vary subtly from frame to frame, and the blue base zone becomes more or less prominent (e.g. faint in frames 1-2, clearer in frames 3, 6, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25).
The candle body, wick and rim stay fixed in the same position relative to the frame edges; no translation or deformation of the solid candle is visible.
At frame 26 a faint gray horizontal band first appears at the very bottom edge (an editing/overlay transition, not physical motion of the scene).

From frame 27 to about frame 33 the lower band grows more opaque and lighter (gray to near-white gradient) while the title text fades from barely legible to crisp dark lettering; the text remains fully visible through the final frame.
The black background and the candle's position are unchanged before, during, and after the overlay fade-in, indicating the overlay is composited on top rather than a change in the filmed scene.
outside_clip_unknowns: What preceded the flickering state at t=0 and what follows the last frame (whether the title band fully resolves, holds, or fades out) is not shown.
The physical cause of the flame's flicker (air movement, wick burn, etc.) is not visible.
Whether the candle is melting over time cannot be judged within this short segment.
uncertain_details: Camera motion: the candle and frame edges remain aligned across all samples, so any camera movement is at most negligible; treat the viewpoint as effectively static.
The exact moment the overlay begins is between frame 25 (no band) and frame 26 (band present); the fade-in of the text is gradual rather than a single cut.
Subtle flame-shape differences between adjacent frames are within normal flicker and should not be read as distinct events.
